story: Our experienced and knowledgeable staff of full-time sales associates and our superior full-time support staff, combined with our conveniently located offices allow us to better serve your real estate needs. Our marketing area covers six counties: Berks, Bucks, Montgomery, Chester, Lancaster and Lehigh, and we have an office located in Boyertown. When you create an account with us, you can save searches and properties, and receive email updates whenever new or changed listings meet your saved searches! Zuber Realty gets a private concept homepage, not a mailed pitch. The page keeps their name in the header, puts industry photography in a 4:5 frame, and makes the next step a call or their official site. Nothing.
